description: Single red apple on white background — model should identify correctly with high confidence

Green salad in a white bowl, seen from above: butterhead lettuce, cherry tomatoes, sliced red chili, fresh herbs, a few nuts, and several slices of cooked meat (could be read as beef, pork or sausage; any of these is acceptable). Should identify the vegetables and the meat with high confidence
Stack of pancakes — common breakfast food, should identify and estimate portions
Classic hamburger — should identify bun, patty, and toppings

Black slate with about ten pieces of nigiri sushi in a row (salmon, tuna, white fish, shrimp and avocado toppings among them), chopsticks and a small bowl of soy sauce beside it, on a dark background. Japanese food, multiple pieces, tests cuisine classification
Shrimp dish — allergen identification; model should correctly identify shrimp (shellfish)

Jar labelled 'Protein Choco Crisp Peanut Butter' with a spoon lifting peanut butter out of it. Slices of brown bread sit beside the jar and a glass of dark drink (tea or coffee) is in the background. Allergen identification: the model must identify peanut butter (peanut); naming the bread and the drink is correct, not invented

Busy restaurant table, shallow focus: the one clear dish is a small plated portion (greens on top of an orange/red base) on a large white plate; a basket of bread is at the left edge; glasses of white wine and water stand behind. Other plates in the background are blurred and should not be itemised with high confidence. Tests multi-food scene detection

Wooden board of RAW meats (not cooked): raw beef steak cuts, raw beef strips, two sausages or frankfurters, a round slab of minced meat or sausage meat, plus cherry tomatoes, herbs and small bowls of peppercorns and lentils. Should identify the raw meat items and estimate portions clearly
Whole mango — single fruit, should identify with high confidence and estimate weight

Well-lit restaurant plate: grilled shellfish tails with herbs (langoustine, scampi, prawn or lobster tail are all acceptable readings), a small bowl of dipping sauce, a green salad, slices of bread, with a glass of beer and a glass of water behind. The exact shellfish species is ambiguous at this size, so confidence on that item should be moderate rather than near-certain; the other items are clear

Overhead view of four dishes on a stone table: a plate of glazed meat pieces with sliced chili, a plate of sliced cooked beef with lettuce and onion rings, a plate of a meat-and-onion salad with herbs, and a small bowl of brown dipping sauce. Loose cashew nuts, red chilies and herbs are scattered between them. Tests enumeration of distinct food items
